evals.prompt: I need a contact form with name, email, and message fields using Mantine. Add validation so name is required (min 2 chars), email is valid format, and message is required (min 10 chars). Use a nice layout with proper spacing.
evals.expected_output: A complete React component using @mantine/form with useForm, TextInput for name and email, Textarea for message, with validation rules, proper layout using Stack/Group, and a Submit button.
assertions: Uses Paper container for form card
Uses Mantine CSS variables for spacing tokens

evals.prompt: Create a responsive dashboard with 3 cards showing Stats, Revenue, and Users. Use Mantine's Paper, Text, Group, Grid components. Make the background colors theme-aware (light/dark). Add a subtle hover effect on each card.
evals.expected_output: A React component with responsive Grid layout, 3 Card/Paper components with theme-aware styling using CSS modules or light-dark(), proper spacing, and hover effects.
assertions: Uses Group for layout within cards
Uses Mantine CSS variables for tokens

evals.prompt: Add a dark mode toggle button to my app. Use Mantine's useMantineColorScheme hook and an ActionIcon. The button should be in the header, show a sun icon in dark mode and moon icon in light mode. Use @tabler/icons-react for icons.
evals.expected_output: A React component that uses useMantineColorScheme hook, ActionIcon with toggle handler, conditional sun/moon icon rendering, and proper accessibility labels.
assertions: Conditionally renders sun icon in dark mode
Conditionally renders moon icon in light mode
Uses colorScheme to determine current scheme

evals.prompt: Build an image carousel with 4 slides using Mantine Carousel. Each slide should show an image with a label overlay. The carousel should loop, show indicators, and have autoplay. Use placeholder images from https://picsum.photos for the images.
evals.expected_output: A React component using @mantine/carousel with Carousel.Slide elements, loop and withIndicators props, autoplay with plugins, and image display with text overlays.

evals.prompt: Create a line chart showing monthly sales and profit data for 6 months. Use Mantine Charts. The chart should have a legend, tooltip, and a curveType of 'natural'. Use sample data with months Jan-Jun.
evals.expected_output: A React component using @mantine/charts LineChart with two series (sales, profit), legend, tooltip, natural curve, and properly typed data.
assertions: Defines data array with monthly entries
Uses series prop with name and color
